description: Search certificates for <domain> — searches Censys's certificate-transparency dataset by domain, SAN, or SHA-256 fingerprint. Returns fingerprint, names (SANs), issuer, and validity window per certificate. Example: censys_cert_search({ q: "names: example.com", per_page: 25, _apiKey: "your-censys-token" })

_apiKey.description: Censys Platform Personal Access Token. Optionally "<token>:<organizationId>".

q.description: Censys certificate query (CenQL), e.g. "names: example.com", "parsed.issuer.organization: \"Let's Encrypt\"", or a SHA-256 fingerprint

name: censys_cert_search
title: Censys Cert Search
